<?php
add_action('rest_api_init', function () {
  register_rest_route('od/v1', '/clone-elementor-course', [
    'methods'  => 'POST',
    'permission_callback' => function () {
      return current_user_can('edit_posts');
    },
    'callback' => function (\WP_REST_Request $req) {
      $template_id = intval($req->get_param('template_id'));
      $target_id   = intval($req->get_param('target_id'));
      $replacements = $req->get_param('replacements');

      if (!$template_id || !$target_id) {
        return new WP_Error('bad_request', 'template_id and target_id required', ['status' => 400]);
      }

      $keys = ['_elementor_data','_elementor_edit_mode','_elementor_version','_wp_page_template'];

      foreach ($keys as $k) {
        $val = get_post_meta($template_id, $k, true);
        if (!is_string($val) || $val === '') continue;

        if ($k === '_elementor_data' && is_array($replacements)) {
          foreach ($replacements as $pair) {
            $from = isset($pair['from']) ? (string)$pair['from'] : '';
            $to   = isset($pair['to']) ? (string)$pair['to'] : '';
            if ($from !== '') $val = str_replace($from, $to, $val);
          }
        }

        update_post_meta($target_id, $k, $val);
      }

      return [
        'success' => true,
        'target_id' => $target_id,
      ];
    },
  ]);
});

<?php
add_action('rest_api_init', function () {
  register_rest_route('od/v1', '/assign-lesson', [
    'methods'  => 'POST',
    'permission_callback' => function () {
      return current_user_can('edit_posts');
    },
    'callback' => function (\WP_REST_Request $req) {
      $lesson_id = intval($req->get_param('lesson_id'));
      $course_id = intval($req->get_param('course_id'));
      $order     = $req->get_param('order');

      if (!$lesson_id || !$course_id) {
        return new WP_Error('bad_request', 'lesson_id and course_id required', ['status' => 400]);
      }

      // Set LearnDash relationship
      update_post_meta($lesson_id, 'course_id', $course_id);

      // Many LearnDash installs also rely on post_parent
      wp_update_post([
        'ID' => $lesson_id,
        'post_parent' => $course_id,
      ]);

      // Optional ordering used by some setups
      if ($order !== null && $order !== '') {
        update_post_meta($lesson_id, 'menu_order', intval($order));
        wp_update_post([
          'ID' => $lesson_id,
          'menu_order' => intval($order),
        ]);
      }

      return [
        'success' => true,
        'lesson_id' => $lesson_id,
        'course_id' => $course_id,
      ];
    },
  ]);
});

<?php
/*
Plugin Name: OD LearnDash Attach Steps (MU)
Description: REST endpoints to attach LearnDash Topics and Quizzes to Lessons, without requiring course_id.
Version: 1.0.0
*/

if (!defined('ABSPATH')) {
  exit;
}

/**
 * Try to resolve a course_id from a lesson/topic/quiz, but do not fail if we cannot.
 */
function od_ld_maybe_resolve_course_id(int $parent_id): int {
  if ($parent_id <= 0) {
    return 0;
  }

  // Prefer LearnDash helper if available
  if (function_exists('learndash_get_course_id')) {
    $cid = (int) learndash_get_course_id($parent_id);
    if ($cid > 0) {
      return $cid;
    }
  }

  // Fallbacks via meta
  $cid = (int) get_post_meta($parent_id, 'course_id', true);
  if ($cid > 0) {
    return $cid;
  }

  $cid = (int) get_post_meta($parent_id, '_ld_course', true);
  if ($cid > 0) {
    return $cid;
  }

  return 0;
}

/**
 * Core helper. attach a child step (topic or quiz) to a lesson.
 * Optionally set course, but never error if course cannot be resolved.
 */
function od_ld_attach_child_to_lesson(int $lesson_id, int $child_id, int $course_id = 0) {
  if ($lesson_id <= 0 || $child_id <= 0) {
    return new WP_Error(
      'invalid_params',
      'lesson_id and child_id must be valid integers.',
      ['status' => 400]
    );
  }

  if (!function_exists('learndash_update_setting')) {
    return new WP_Error(
      'learndash_missing',
      'LearnDash functions not available. Is LearnDash active',
      ['status' => 500]
    );
  }

  // Attach child to lesson
  learndash_update_setting($child_id, 'lesson', $lesson_id);

  // Try to set course if we have or can infer it, but do not fail if we cannot
  if ($course_id <= 0) {
    $course_id = od_ld_maybe_resolve_course_id($lesson_id);
  }
  if ($course_id > 0) {
    learndash_update_setting($child_id, 'course', $course_id);
  }

  return [
    'success'    => true,
    'lesson_id'  => $lesson_id,
    'child_id'   => $child_id,
    'course_id'  => $course_id > 0 ? $course_id : null,
  ];
}

add_action('rest_api_init', function () {

  /**
   * POST /wp-json/od/v1/attach-step
   *
   * Body JSON.
   * {
   *   "lesson_id": 1234,
   *   "child_id": 5678,
   *   "course_id": 9999   // optional
   * }
   */
  register_rest_route('od/v1', '/attach-step', [
    'methods'  => 'POST',
    'permission_callback' => function () {
      return function_exists('current_user_can') ? current_user_can('edit_posts') : false;
    },
    'callback' => function (WP_REST_Request $request) {

      $lesson_id = (int) $request->get_param('lesson_id');
      $child_id  = (int) $request->get_param('child_id');
      $course_id = (int) $request->get_param('course_id');

      if ($lesson_id <= 0 || $child_id <= 0) {
        return new WP_Error(
          'invalid_params',
          'lesson_id and child_id are required.',
          ['status' => 400]
        );
      }

      $res = od_ld_attach_child_to_lesson($lesson_id, $child_id, $course_id);
      return $res;
    },
  ]);

  /**
   * POST /wp-json/od/v1/attach-steps-bulk
   *
   * Body JSON.
   * {
   *   "items": [
   *     { "lesson_id": 1234, "child_id": 5678, "course_id": 9999 },
   *     { "lesson_id": 1234, "child_id": 5679 }
   *   ]
   * }
   */
  register_rest_route('od/v1', '/attach-steps-bulk', [
    'methods'  => 'POST',
    'permission_callback' => function () {
      return function_exists('current_user_can') ? current_user_can('edit_posts') : false;
    },
    'callback' => function (WP_REST_Request $request) {

      $items = $request->get_param('items');

      if (!is_array($items) || count($items) === 0) {
        return new WP_Error(
          'invalid_params',
          'items must be a non empty array.',
          ['status' => 400]
        );
      }

      $results = [];

      foreach ($items as $i => $it) {
        $lesson_id = isset($it['lesson_id']) ? (int) $it['lesson_id'] : 0;
        $child_id  = isset($it['child_id']) ? (int) $it['child_id'] : 0;
        $course_id = isset($it['course_id']) ? (int) $it['course_id'] : 0;

        if ($lesson_id <= 0 || $child_id <= 0) {
          $results[] = [
            'index'   => $i,
            'success' => false,
            'error'   => 'lesson_id and child_id are required',
          ];
          continue;
        }

        $res = od_ld_attach_child_to_lesson($lesson_id, $child_id, $course_id);

        if (is_wp_error($res)) {
          $results[] = [
            'index'    => $i,
            'success'  => false,
            'lesson_id'=> $lesson_id,
            'child_id' => $child_id,
            'error'    => $res->get_error_message(),
          ];
        } else {
          $results[] = array_merge(['index' => $i], $res);
        }
      }

      return [
        'success' => true,
        'results' => $results,
      ];
    },
  ]);

});
